title: Multiplexed profiling of transcriptional regulators in plant cells.
authors: Alamos, Simon; Waldburger, Lucas; Dee, Amanda; Owens, Lauren A; Rattan, Rohan; Ong, Shirlyne; Shih, Patrick M
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了植物细胞中高通量转录调控活性筛选方法ENTRAP-seq，结合机器学习表征病毒蛋白和转录因子变体的调控功能，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Transcriptional regulators play key roles in plant growth, development and environmental responses; however, understanding how their regulatory activity is encoded at the protein level has been hindered by a lack of multiplexed large-scale methods to characterize protein libraries in planta. Here we present enrichment of nuclear trans-elements reporter assay in plants with sequencing (ENTRAP-seq), a high-throughput method that introduces protein-coding libraries into plant cells to drive a nuclear magnetic sorting-based reporter, enabling multiplexed measurement of regulatory activity from thousands of protein variants. Using ENTRAP-seq and machine learning, we screen 1,495 plant viruses and identify hundreds of putative transcriptional regulatory domains found in structural proteins and enzymes not associated with gene regulation. In addition, we combine ENTRAP-seq with machine-guided design to engineer the activity of a plant transcription factor in a semirational fashion. Our findings demonstrate how scalable protein function assays deployed in planta will enable the characterization of natural and synthetic coding diversity in plants.
abstract_zh: 转录调控因子在植物生长、发育和环境响应中发挥关键作用；然而，由于缺乏在植物体内（in planta）表征蛋白质文库的多重大规模方法，理解其调控活性如何在蛋白质水平上被编码一直受到阻碍。在此，我们提出植物中核转座元件报告基因富集测序法（ENTRAP-seq），这是一种高通量方法，将蛋白质编码文库引入植物细胞以驱动基于核磁分选的报告基因，从而实现对数千种蛋白质变体调控活性的多重测量。利用ENTRAP-seq和机器学习，我们筛选了1,495种植物病毒，并鉴定出数百个推定转录调控结构域，这些结构域存在于结构蛋白和与基因调控无关的酶中。此外，我们将ENTRAP-seq与机器引导设计相结合，以半理性方式工程化改造一种植物转录因子的活性。我们的发现展示了在植物体内部署的可扩展蛋白质功能测定方法如何能够表征植物中天然和合成编码多样性。
